The pair a row's last execution carried out, read as the 0.25.0 read it

log_executed_unverified.Rd

The value each of fields had in the version the round last carried out: the newest write of the field below the round's newest execution, log_executions(), in the row's current life, by anybody, the channel included. The creation carries the fields a referent filled in, server = 'edc10', and the identity door the username the round resolved, which it writes before the seal in the same pass. A write below the seal that the execution did not cover, log_uncovered_writes(), is passed over: made while the round ran, it holds a value the round had not read, and the one below it is what was carried out.

Usage

log_executed_unverified(
  events,
  record,
  creator,
  fields = c("server", "project_id", "username"),
  approvers = character(),
  channel_account = NULL
)

Arguments

events

The event log, as register_log() returns it.

record

The record id to look at.

creator

Who created the row, as log_creators() answers, for log_uncovered_writes().

fields

The fields to read.

approvers

The IT accounts whose approval counts on any row.

channel_account

The REDCap usernames that hold the round's token, one or more, or NULL when they are not configured.

Value

A character vector named by fields, NA where the log does not say: the row was never carried out in its current life, the log holds no write of the field below the seal, the stretch below the seal cannot be read, or the channel is not known.

Details

Not verified by the seal, and wrong in three cases the reconstruction gets right (review of the 0.24.0): a change carried out with no approval above it (A4), the owner's own write while the round ran (B), the person written while it ran (B2). Kept for the rows whose reconstruction is not verified, and for the rule of the pair only (decided on 2026-11-12).

The value is read whole, up to the apostrophe that closes it, the one followed by the next field or by the end of details: a UPN can hold an apostrophe, and cut at the first one luca.d'amico would read luca.d.
